approval_evidence.quote: NDA 21-446 ... LYRICA (pregabalin) Capsules ... management of neuropathic pain associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy ... it is approved, effective on the date of this letter (signed 12/30/04)

series_start_reason: Pfizer's own releases for the third and fourth quarters of 2004 print no Lyrica row. The first row in a release is the first-quarter 2005 release (Lyrica 20 | 0); the prior-year columns of the third-quarter 2005 and fourth-quarter 2005 releases print 2 and 11 for 2004Q3 and 2004Q4 (the earlier 2004 quarters print 0 in the 2005 releases' prior-year columns), so the series starts 2004Q3. No issuer document dating the first sale was cited; the 2005-10-20 release says Lyrica was 'First launched one year ago in Germany and the U.K.' (approximate), so launch_quarter is null.

unreported_quarters.2020Q4: Ownership change Pfizer to Viatris. Pfizer's last Lyrica row is the third-quarter 2020 release (2020-10-27: 'Lyrica | 352 | 527'); the Upjohn business combined with Mylan to form Viatris on 2020-11-16; Pfizer's fourth-quarter 2020 release (2021-02-02) prints no Lyrica row. Viatris first prints Lyrica in its first-quarter 2021 release (2021-05-10: 'Lyrica | 187.8', no prior-year figure); its FY2020 10-K carries no Lyrica revenue and its fourth-quarter 2021 release has no 2020 comparative. No document gives a full 2020Q4 figure.

notes: Worldwide total Lyrica. Pfizer printed a single Lyrica line to 2015Q2; from 2015Q3 to 2018Q4 it printed Lyrica-GIP/IH and Lyrica-GEP/EH separately plus a 'Total Lyrica' row (footnote: 'Total Lyrica revenues represent the aggregate of worldwide revenues from Lyrica-GIP and Lyrica-GEP'), and from 2019Q1 a single Lyrica row again. The Total Lyrica row is used for 2015Q3-2018Q4; 2016Q4 is not printed in its own release (2017-01-31 prints only the IH and EH rows) and is read from the prior-year column of the 2017Q4 release (Total Lyrica 1,236). The U.S. loss of exclusivity (multi-source generics from July 2019) lowers the series from 2019Q3. Annual sums of Pfizer quarters match the Q4 release twelve-month rows within rounding (2005 291, 2008 2,573, 2013 4,595, 2015 4,839, 2016 4,966 vs the 4,966 prior-year column of the 2017Q4 release, 2019 3,321). Viatris prints Lyrica in its Key Product Net Sales table.
search_log: listed Pfizer filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages, CIK 0000078003), every 8-K and 8-K/A with Item 2.02 from 2010-02 to 2026-08 and the earnings 8-Ks of 2003-2009 (Items 12/9/2.02) and 2001-10-24 / 2002-07-16; downloaded each EX-99 and parsed the product-revenue table rows

Pfizer: single Lyrica row to 2015Q2 (plain or 'Lyrica (c)'/'(d)' with a GIP/GEP cell); 'Total Lyrica (c)' rows 2015Q3-2018Q4 except 2016Q4; plain 'Lyrica' 2019Q1-2020Q3; each quarter from its own release except 2004Q3, 2004Q4 and 2016Q4 (prior-year columns)
Pre-2005 releases (2004-10-20, 2005-01-19) searched for a Lyrica row: none; Q4 2004 value 11 and Q3 2004 value 2 come from the prior-year columns of 2006-01-19 and 2005-10-20
Pfizer 2020Q4 and Viatris: same evidence as Lipitor (Pfizer Q4 2020 release has no Lyrica row; Viatris 8-K releases 2021-05-10 onward; Viatris FY2020 10-K has no Lyrica revenue)
